# Usage Jump Around S-TUN-002 Due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by external event EVT-001 matching the timing and location of the traffic increase on S-TUN-002 and neighboring sites, with configuration changes (T5) and maintenance windows (T8) checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 18:15 to 2026-09-11 21:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 18:18
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

Traffic and user surge caused by a football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) near the affected sites.

Traffic and user metrics spiked above baseline for sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 starting at 2026-09-11 18:15 and recovering by 2026-09-11 21:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 18:15: Earliest KPI onset detected with S-TUN-003 dl_volume_mb above baseline. [T4]
- 2026-09-11 18:18: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) started near S-TUN-001. [T3, EVT-001]
- 2026-09-11 18:30: S-TUN-002 dl_volume_mb, active_users, and prb_util_pct rose above baseline; ALR-0018 alert ended. [T1, T4, ALR-0018, ANM-000150, ANM-000151, ANM-000156]
- 2026-09-11 18:45: S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 metrics showed significant deviation above baseline. [T4]
- 2026-09-11 21:30: Most affected site metrics recovered to normal baseline levels. [T4]
- 2026-09-11 21:43: External event EVT-001 ended. [T3, EVT-001]
- 2026-09-11 21:45: S-TUN-002 active_users recovered to baseline, completing the recovery window. [T4]

## Evidence

- Detector alert overlapping 2026-09-11 16:00 to 2026-09-12 08:18 was registered for S-TUN-002. [T1]
- An external stadium event (EVT-001) took place at Stade Olympique de Rades from 2026-09-11 18:18 to 21:43. [T3, EVT-001]
- KPI deviations occurred across 9 of 9 series for S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 starting at 2026-09-11 18:15. [T4]
- No configuration changes were executed on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003, or their parents between 2026-09-11 17:00 and 2026-09-12 00:00. [T5]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003, or their parents during the relevant time window. [T8]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. The timing, location, and magnitude of the traffic and user surge perfectly coincide with the football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) and affect nearby sites without any accompanying network faults or changes. [T1, T3, T4, EVT-001]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-002: rejected. No configuration changes occurred on the affected sites or their ancestor nodes during the incident window. [T5]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-TUN-002: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites or their ancestors during the incident window. [T8]

## Ruled out

- T5: Rule out bad configuration changes as a cause since no changes were performed on the nodes or their parents.
- T8: Rule out planned maintenance activities as no maintenance was scheduled during the time window.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor similar large-scale stadium events proactively to anticipate capacity and traffic spikes on neighboring cell sites.
